name: Qwen3.5-9B · Tool 2-shot Baseline

name: Qwen2.5-7B · SFT external rollout v3 · 4 epoch
description: Four-epoch QLoRA run on the DS v4 flash closed-loop external-rollout dataset. Each epoch was checkpointed; epoch2 and epoch4 were evaluated on Spider dev, then their context_overflow/execution_error buckets were rerun with only context length and max trajectory steps relaxed.

related_evaluations.label: Tool zero-shot full dev · epoch 2 checkpoint · original
Tool zero-shot full dev · epoch 4 checkpoint · original

notes: Training completed on table_rl. Original full Spider dev: epoch2 682/1034 = 65.96% (97 context_overflow, 42 execution_error); epoch4 715/1034 = 69.15% (71 context_overflow, 40 execution_error). Controlled retry on only the original context_overflow+execution_error buckets relaxed only context length to 16k and max_steps to 50: epoch2 recovered 35/139, implying an upper merged score about 717/1034 = 69.34%; epoch4 recovered 32/111, implying about 747/1034 = 72.24%. Error retry budget remained 3. Scoring audit after registration found the previous broad-evidence projection rule was optimistic: among recorded successes, old broad-table projection accounted for 146 epoch2 original, 11 epoch2 retry, 142 epoch4 original, and 9 epoch4 retry cases. Current rollout.py is tightened to allow same-width column-order permutations only; rerun before treating these numbers as strict final scores. Audit artifact: data/results/scoring_audit_external_rollout_v3_20260708.json.
